securityInvariants: Do not fork upstream n8n core merely to reproduce customer-site chrome.
Do not expose workflow credentials, execution payloads, tokens, or secrets through content or theme APIs.
Do not weaken native project, workflow, credential, CSRF, session, or authorization controls.
Do not store access, refresh, or identity tokens in browser local storage.
Do not make the editor a public customer surface.
Do not activate workflows or external effects as part of theme or SSO adoption.
requiredEvidenceBeforeRuntimeGo: DNS, TLS, ingress, and canonical domain ownership verified
Keycloak client, redirect URI, audience, scopes, logout, and session revocation verified
operator roles and project/credential permissions verified
session-expired, unauthorized, maintenance, and error states verified
dangerous-node exclusions and Middleware-only egress verified
upgrade compatibility against the pinned n8n version verified
backup, isolated restore, disable, and rollback rehearsal completed
exact source SHA and runtime artifact digest read back from staging
independent approval of the unchanged implementation head

dependencies.purpose: interactive operator identity, roles, sessions, logout, and revocation
protected ingress, TLS, redirect routing, and gateway policy
approved semantic tokens and shared identity contracts where supported
environment, monitoring, immutable deployment, and rollback controls
